content: Midiyaame Bolla Dendida Ola
Goday Museko,
“Isra7eele asaa qohida gisho Midiyaame asaa olada halo keya; hessafe guye, neeni hayqada ne mayzata gakana” yaagis.
Hessa gisho, Musey asaako, “Midiyaame asaa olidi Godaa halo keyana mela hinte giddofe guutha asaa olas dancisite.
Issi issi Isra7eele kochaafe issi mukulu adde asaa olas yeddite” yaagis.
Hessa gisho, issi issi Isra7eele kochaafe issi issi mukulu asay keyidi, tammanne nam7u mukulu olanchoti olas giigidosona.
Musey kahiniya Alaazara na7aa Pinihaasa aawatethan, issi issi kochaafe issi issi mukulu asi dooridi olas yeddis; Pinihaasi bishe geeshsha miishetanne mallas punniya zaye ekidi bis.
Goday Muse kiitidaysada, enti Midiyaame asaa olidi adde ubbaa wodhidosona.
Ichashu Midiyaame kawota, Ewa, Reqeema, Zura, Huranne Reeba geetetiya asata wodhidosona; qassi Bi7oora na7aa Balaamaka mashshan wodhidosona.
Isra7eele asay Midiyaame maccasaanne nayta di7idosona; enta mehiya, dorsaanne deesha wudiyanne enta miishe ubbaa di7idosona.
Enti de7iya katamatanne enta gutata ubbaa xuuggidosona.
Asaa mehiyanne de7idaba ubbaa ekidi bidosona.
Enti di7ida asaa, mehiyanne shalo ubbaa Iyaarkofe hefinthan, Yordaanose shaafa matan de7iya Moo7abe denban dunkaanida Museko, kahiniya Alaazarakonne Isra7eele maabaraako ehidosona.
Musey, kahiniya Alaazarinne maabara halaqati ubbay dunkaanida gutaape gaxa keyidi entana mokidosona.
Musey olape simmida tora moconata, shaalaqatanne mato halaqata bolla hanqetis.
Musey entako, “Maccasa ubbaa ayis wodhibeeketii?
Enti Balaama zoriya si7idi, Pe7oora geetetiya bessan Isra7eele asay Godaa aggidi, boshan hayqanaada oothiday maccasa gideysa dogidetii?
Hessa gisho, ha77i adde naytanne addera aqida maccas ubbaa wodhite.
Shin addera aqiboona macca nayta ubbaa hintew ashshite.
Hinte giddofe ase wodhida asi woyko aha bochida oonika gutaape gaxan laapun gallas utto; heedzantho gallasaninne laapuntha gallasan hintenanne hinte di77ida asaa geeshshite.
Hessadaka ma7o ubbaa, galbafe, deesha ikisepenne mithafe oosetidabata ubbaa geeshshite” yaagis.
Kahiney Alaazari olape simmida olanchotako, “Goday Muses immida higgiya maaray haysa;
Worqa, bira, naase, birata, qorqoro, irsaase,
taman meetetonnabati ubbay taman geeyanaw bessees. Shin taman meetetiyabati geeshsho haathan geeyanaw bessees.
Laapuntha gallasan hinte ma7uwa meeccite; hintena geeshshite. Hessafe guye, gutaa gelite” yaagis.
Di77idabaa Shaaketidosona
Goday Museko,
“Neera, kahiniya Alaazararanne Isra7eele maabara halaqati di7etida asaanne mehiya taybite.
Ola bidaysatasinne boonnaysatas nam7u kessidi shaakite.
Ola bidaysata gishuwape ase gidin miizi gidin hare gidin dorse woyko deeshe gidin ichashu xeetape issino Godaas immite.
Enta gishuwape ekida Godaa imota kahiniya Alaazaras immite.
Hanko Isra7eeleta gakida gishuwape, ase gidin miizi gidin hare gidin dorse woyko deeshe gidin ishatammaafe issino ekidi Godaa Dunkaaniya aawatethan aysiya Leewetas immite” yaagis.
Museynne kahiney Alaazari Goday kiitidaysada oothidosona.
Olanchoti bantaw ekin attida di7oy 675,000 dorsata, 72,000 miizata, 61,000 haretanne 32,000 geela7o macca nayta.
Ola bidaysata gakida gishoy 337,500 dorsata;
entafe Godaas imetiday 675.
Miizati 36,000; entafe Godaas imetiday 72.
Hareti 30,500; entafe Godaas imetiday 61.
Maccasati 16,000; entafe Godaas imetiday 32.
Goday Muse kiitidaysada Godaa imota kahiniya Alaazaras immis.
Ola boonna Isra7eele maabara gakida gishoy ola bida asaa gishuwara issi gina; ika 337,500 dorsata, 36,000 miizata, 30,500 haretanne 16,000 geela7o macca nayta.
Isra7eele maabara gakida gishuwape ishatamu asaapenne mehiyape isso isso kessidi Goday iya kiitidaysada geeshsha Dunkaaniya aawatethan aysiya Leewetas immis.
Hessafe guye, tora moconati, shaalaqatinne mato halaqati Museko shiiqidi,
“Nuuni ne aylleti nu aawatetha garsan de7iya olanchota taybin issoyka pacibeenna.
Goday nu shempuwa ashshida gisho, nu issoy issoy ekida worqa alleeqota, sagaayota, toho albota, migiddota, haytha worqatanne qoodhe worqata Godaas immanaw ekidi yida” yaagidosona.
Museynne kahiney Alaazari worqa alleeqota ubbaa entafe ekidosona.
Shaalaqatinne mato halaqati Godaas immida worqay nam7u xeetu kilo giraame gidis.
Hanko olanchoti ehida di7uwa bantaw ekidosona.
Museynne kahiney Alaazari shalaqatapenne mato halaqatape ekida worqa Godaa sinthan Isra7eele asaa hassayisiyaba oothidi geeshsha dunkaaniya giddo ehidosona.
